title: The Hastening Decay Canon
summary: A canon on speeding the age of plate and cord and gear with entropy qi and on unmaking the bane that clings to a friend.

title: A Treatise on Vitality Drain
summary: A treatise on pulling vitality out of a foe in threads and in floods and on drawing venom out of the bitten.

title: The Cessation Field Course
summary: A course in spreading the qi field as an aura of ending that slows every living thing inside it and settles sickness.

title: The Twin Wither Treatise
summary: A treatise on withering in pairs so a second touch finishes what the first began and a second hand undoes the harm.

title: Compendium of the Falling Ash Rite
summary: A compendium on a rite of ash falling through the qi field to smother foes and lay a taint to rest.

title: The Hawk's Last Stoop
summary: A manual of the plunging final stroke that ends a foe's strength from above and the quiet that follows it.

title: The Wind-Sworn Wither Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the wither that rides a gust and the oath to carry sickness off on the same wind.

title: Manual of the Dying Gust
summary: A manual of gusts that die in the foe's lungs and of breezes that bear a poison out of a friend.

title: Treatise on Bearing and the Last Breath
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing on a foe's breath and ending it and on easing a sworn friend's sickness along the same line.
